parameters.query:
SELECT r.id AS review_id, r.rating, r.comment, r.first_name AS reviewer_first_name,
       b.id AS business_id, b.name AS business_name,
       u.email AS business_owner_email, u.first_name AS owner_first_name
FROM reviews r
JOIN businesses b ON b.id = r.business_id
JOIN user_businesses ub ON ub.business_id = b.id
JOIN users u ON u.id = ub.user_id
WHERE r.id = $1
LIMIT 1;
